attachments.name: STRIKE FORCE
attachments.bonusInstruction: While attacking, reroll each red die showing only 1 {H} result, each blue or green die showing no {H} results, and each yellow die showing only the single {B}.

attachments.name: ASSASSINS
attachments.bonusInstruction: Figures do not block line of sight for your attacks. Once per round, while attacking, reroll each red die showing only 1 {H} result, each blue or green die showing no {H} results, and each yellow die showing only the single {B}.
